target_text: // Each head has its own accumulator, so the split changes no head's add order.
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

The two calls below (qk_group<MAX_KV_MUL_16> then qk_group<kv_mul - MAX_KV_MUL_16>) already say 'first 16, then the rest', and the recursion is visible. The one fact the code does not say is the numerics consequence stated in the header (lines 48-49): per-head accumulators mean the split keeps every head's add order; that line belongs here, next to the split.

Proposed:
```cpp
    // Each head has its own accumulator, so the split changes no head's add order.
```
